title: Leave No One Behind
html:
Leave No One Behind is an achievement in Baldur's Gate 3 that requires the party to save a specific subset[1] of the Tiefling Refugees. If the conditions are met, this achievement is awarded upon completing the game.

Act One

Tiefling Refugees
(Act 1)
The Hollow
  • Alfira
  • Bex
  • Cal
  • Dammon
  • Danis
  • Ide
  • Lakrissa
  • Lia
  • Rolan
  • Umi
  • Zorru
Secluded Chamber
  • Zevlor
Tiefling Hideout
  • Mol
Inner Sanctum
  • Arabella
  • v
  • t
  • e

Specific tiefling refugees in the Emerald Grove must survive. This requires the party to complete the ⁠Save the Refugees questline, siding with the tieflings throughout and, depending on the choices the party made, ensuring their survival against goblins or hostile druids. The  Rite of Thorns must also not be completed.

See list to the right for a full name list of all tieflings that must be alive at the end of Act One.

Special mentions

The below must all be accounted for before ⁠Defeat the Goblins is complete.

  •  Rolan: Found in the grove with his siblings. He must be convinced to stay with the rest of the refugees due to events of Act Two.
  •  Arabella: Found in the Inner Sanctum, where  Kagha must be convinced to spare her.
  •  Cerys only appears in this act if  Zevlor has died, thus her appearance means the achievement has failed.
  • If the The Dark Urge is chosen as origin,  Alfira must be knocked out non-lethally on the day their special long rest event triggers. She is then replaced by a Dragonborn bard  Quil during Dark Urge's personal camp event. If successful, Alfira does not disappear from her position in the Emerald Grove.

Act Two

Tiefling Refugees
(Act 2)
Last Light Inn
  • Alfira
  • Bex
  • Cerys
  • Dammon
  • Mol
  • Ide
  • Umi
Shadow-Cursed Lands
  • Arabella
  • Rolan
Moonrise Towers Prison
  • Cal
  • Danis
  • Lakrissa
  • Lia
Mind Flayer Colony
  • Zevlor
  • v
  • t
  • e

In Act Two, many of the tieflings are - unavoidably - either missing or dead. Refer to the list to the right to see who must be accounted for and kept alive for this achievement.

The Last Light Inn must not fall at any point. This includes keeping  Isobel safe during ⁠Resolve the Abduction, where tieflings must survive the raid, as well as ensuring  Nightsong is saved in ⁠Find the Nightsong.

Special mentions

The below should be accounted for before the party enter the Shadowfell as part of the ⁠Find the Nightsong, with the exception of Zevlor and Mol.

  •  Cerys: Found inside the Last Light Inn. Cerys can easily be mistaken for a member of the Harpers unless the party talk to her and learn that she was a member of the refugees who was busy scouting during Act One. She must be kept alive through ⁠Resolve the Abduction just like the other Tieflings.
  •  Dammon: Found right outside the Last Light Inn. Dammon must be protected if choosing to fight the Strange Ox.
  •  Rolan: Initially found in Last Light Inn, but leaves to find his siblings. The party must then save him in the Ruined Battlefield X: -54 Y: -111.
  •  Bex,  Ide, and Umi: Found in Last Light Inn, as long as Rolan and his siblings were convinced to stay in the Emerald Grove in Act One.
  •  Arabella: Found near the graveyard in Reithwin Town X: -153 Y: 15. Her quest ⁠Find Arabella's Parents must be completed.
  •  Cal,  Danis,  Lakrissa and  Lia: Imprisoned in Moonrise Towers and must be rescued with everyone surviving. The party must speak to Alfira upon returning to Last Light Inn for completion. The party can also speak to the other rescued tieflings for various rewards. See also ⁠Rescue the Tieflings.
  •  Mol: Will always be captured during ⁠Resolve the Abduction and does not appear until Act Three. See also ⁠Find Mol.
  •  Zevlor: Must be rescued in the Illithid Colony. See also ⁠Find Zevlor.

Deceased or missing

  • The following can be found deceased in the shadow-cursed lands. Their deaths cannot be avoided and do not have an impact on getting the achievement:
    Amek, Asharak, Elegis, Ikaron, Kaldani, Komira, Locke, Memnos, Rechel, Toron, Xeph.
  • The following always are missing and do not show up in the game again:
    Arka, Damays, Doni, Eramas, Gan, Guex, Nadira, Nymessa, Okta, Pandirna, Rikka, Tilses, Zaki.
  • The following are temporarily missing, but show up later in Act Three: Zorru
  • The following are temporarily missing and do not have an impact on getting the achievement, but show up later in Act Three:
    Silfy

Most of the surviving tieflings can be found in the refugee camps in Rivington, though some have made it into the Lower City.

At this point in the game, no major events endanger the refugees.

Special mentions

  •  Rolan: Found at the Sorcerous Sundries. Rolan must not die if the party chooses to fight  Lorroakan.
  •  Mol: Found in the Guildhall. She must be spoken to for the completion of Find Mol and cannot be allowed to die during the battle between the Guild and the Zhentarim during Aid the Underduke.
  •  Zevlor: Zevlor cannot be found in Act Three until the end of the game. He must survive if he is summoned using  Gather Your Allies during the final battle.

Missing

  • In addition to the list of missing tieflings in Act Two,  Meli cannot be found anywhere.

Bugs

  • Achievement may incorrectly unlock early if saving tieflings missed in a previous playthrough.

Notes and references
